# A splash (generated by make_env.py), origin at the water.
new
material new Spray --base-color 0.788 0.800 0.631 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name Drop0 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.16 --location 0.450 0.000 0.35
material assign Spray
add mesh ico-sphere --name Drop1 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.16 --location 0.225 0.390 0.5
material assign Spray
add mesh ico-sphere --name Drop2 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.16 --location -0.225 0.390 0.35
material assign Spray
add mesh ico-sphere --name Drop3 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.16 --location -0.450 0.000 0.5
material assign Spray
add mesh ico-sphere --name Drop4 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.16 --location -0.225 -0.390 0.35
material assign Spray
add mesh ico-sphere --name Drop5 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.16 --location 0.225 -0.390 0.5
material assign Spray
add mesh cone --name Column --vertices 6 --radius1 0.35 --radius2 0.12 --depth 0.9 --location 0 0 0.45
material assign Spray
select all
shade flat
export splash.glb
